title_sq: Shtepi 2 kateshe ne shitje ne zonen e 21 Dhjetorit prane Policise Bashkiake ne Tirane (ID 4141022)
description_sq:
Ne zonen e 21 Dhjetorit prane Policise Bashkiake shitet shtepi 2 kateshe, siperfaqe totale 240.1 m², (siperfaqe trualli 121 m²). Godina organizohet ne nje dyqan ne katin perdhe, dhe nje apartament 3+1, ne katin e pare. Apartamenti organizohet ne nje dhome ndenje te bollshme me aneks gatimi, 3 dhoma gjumi, 3 tualete, 2 ballkone te medhenj. Godina ka nje tarace te aksesueshme me shkalle dhe te shfrytezueshme. Themelet jane hedhur per 4 kate dhe ne tarace jane hekurat per te vazhduar ndertesen. Mundesi e mire per ta shnderruar ne biznes.
Shitet 350000 Euro
title_en: 2-storey house for sale in the area of ​​21 December near the Municipal Police in Tirana (ID 4141022)
description_en: In the area of ​​21 December, near the Municipal Police, a 2-story house is for sale, total area 240.1 m², (land area 121 m²). The building is organized in a shop on the ground floor, and a 3+1 apartment on the first floor. The apartment is organized in a spacious living room with kitchenette, 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 2 large balconies. The building has a terrace accessible by stairs and usable. The foundations have been laid for 4 floors and there are bars on the terrace to continue the building. Good opportunity to turn it into a business. For sale 350000 Euro
